tagline: Import from Power BI and Tableau: Importing reports and data models from Power BI and Tableau with Genie Code (/importBI) is now generally available.
what_it_does: Import from Power BI and Tableau: Importing reports and data models from Power BI and Tableau with Genie Code (/importBI) is now generally available. Larger Excel downloads: You can now download up to 1 million rows from a dashboard widget to Excel (.xlsx), up from 100,000. Multi select and move widgets: Dashboard authors can now select multiple widgets and move them together on the canvas by holding Cmd or Ctrl while clicking.
why_it_matters: + Improved layout placement: Genie Code now places widgets in appropriate locations instead of leaving large gaps in the dashboard layout.
